style.backgroundSystem: deep navy #172447 and royal blue #2B4A8C diagonal geometric panels for hero and infographic screens, cool light grey #E6E8EE for macro and kit shots, pure white #FFFFFF for the compliant packshot
style.iconSystem: thin-line icons and thin outline rings, single glass-blue accent color
style.lightingSystem: cool-neutral studio lighting with a soft rim light tracing the glass edge, controlled soft reflections on the glass, gentle violet screen glow, soft contact shadows; straight lines stay perfectly straight
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent premium tech accessory ecommerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of deep navy background #172447, royal blue #2B4A8C, cool light grey #E6E8EE, pure white #FFFFFF, charcoal text #2D2D2D, pale glass-blue accent #7FA3E0 and soft violet screen glow #7B6BD9; cool-neutral tone throughout; modern geometric sans-serif type; consistent diagonal geometric panel backgrounds and rounded info cards; thin-line icons with a single glass-blue accent; crisp studio product lighting with a soft rim light along the glass edge and controlled soft reflections; stable hero product angle and scale; every screen composed as one complete balanced layout with natural breathing margins; straight lines on the glass and the phone must stay perfectly straight; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles, no warped straight edges.
noDrift: no warped straight edges on glass or phone
no visible brand names on phone or accessories
style.presentationRules: stable slight 3/4 or straight-on hero presentation of the protector on a generic unbranded smartphone; consistent scale of phone and protector across the set; every screen composed as one complete balanced layout with natural breathing margins
style.surfaceSystem: matte cool light-grey panel #E6E8EE and seamless studio backdrops, no wood or fabric texture in studio shots
style.typography: modern geometric sans-serif type for short headlines and labels in #FFFFFF on dark panels or #2D2D2D on light panels, a small English category caption allowed as a positional element
